desc.de: Skalierbare VMs. 1.000+ Instance-Typen (General Purpose, Compute, Memory, Storage, Accelerated/GPU). Spot Instances, Placement Groups, Dedicated Hosts, Nitro-Architektur, ENA.
desc.en: Scalable VMs. 1,000+ instance types (general purpose, compute, memory, storage, accelerated/GPU). Spot instances, placement groups, dedicated hosts, Nitro architecture, ENA.

tcpDesc.de: VMs mit Flavor-Naming: Typ.Generation.RAM-Ratio (z.B. s3.large.2 = General Purpose Gen3, 1:2 RAM). Typen: s (General), c (Dedicated General Purpose), m (Memory), e (Large Memory), d/i (Disk-intensive/Ultra-high I/O), x (Flexible Purpose), g/p/pi (GPU: T4, L4, A40, V100, A100, H100; H200 laut Roadmap Dez 2026–Mär 2027). Windows/Linux, VPC-Integration, Multi-AZ, Auto Scaling. Keine Spot-Instanzen (Pay-per-Use oder Reserved). Server Groups (ECS-Gruppen) für Anti-Affinity. ⚠️ EOL e3, pi2, p2s/p2v und End of Sale c3/c3n/m3/m3n zum 31.12.2026. Hyper-Threading pro Instanz ein-/ausschaltbar laut Roadmap bis Jan 2027 (AWS: CPU-Optionen).
tcpDesc.en: VMs with flavor naming: type.generation.RAM-ratio (e.g. s3.large.2 = General Purpose Gen3, 1:2 RAM). Types: s (general), c (dedicated general purpose), m (memory), e (large memory), d/i (disk-intensive/ultra-high I/O), x (flexible purpose), g/p/pi (GPU: T4, L4, A40, V100, A100, H100; H200 on the roadmap for Dec 2026–Mar 2027). Windows/Linux, VPC integration, multi-AZ, Auto Scaling. No spot instances (pay-per-use or reserved). Server groups (ECS groups) for anti-affinity. ⚠️ EOL e3, pi2, p2s/p2v and end of sale c3/c3n/m3/m3n on 31.12.2026. Enabling/disabling hyper-threading per instance is on the roadmap until Jan 2027 (AWS: CPU options).

migration.de: **Flavor-Schema.** m5.large (2 vCPU, 8 GiB) → c9.large.4 — Suffix gibt RAM-Ratio an (.4 = 1:4 vCPU:RAM). GPU-Flavors (A100, H100) verfügbar. **Image-Formate.** AMI-Export nur als VMDK/RAW/VHD, kein QCOW2. **Netzwerk & Security.** Security Groups max 50 Regeln (AWS: 60). Kein Nitro/ENA — EVS-Performance-Tiers prüfen. Elastic IPs pro Region limitiert. **Cloud-Init.** User Data Scripts prüfen — Versionsunterschiede zwischen AWS und T Cloud Public können Probleme machen. **Spot & Placement.** Keine Spot-Instanzen — Pay-per-Use oder Reserved nutzen. Placement Groups → nur Server Groups mit Anti-Affinity. **Nicht verfügbar.** Keine Capacity Reservations (Dedicated Hosts → DeH).
migration.en: **Flavor schema.** m5.large (2 vCPU, 8 GiB) → c9.large.4 — suffix indicates RAM ratio (.4 = 1:4 vCPU:RAM). GPU flavors (A100, H100) available. **Image formats.** AMI export only as VMDK/RAW/VHD, no QCOW2. **Networking & security.** Security groups max 50 rules (AWS: 60). No Nitro/ENA — check EVS performance tiers. Elastic IPs limited per region. **Cloud-Init.** Check User Data scripts — version differences between AWS and T Cloud Public can cause issues. **Spot & placement.** No spot instances — use pay-per-use or reserved. Placement Groups → only Server Groups with anti-affinity. **Not available.** No capacity reservations (dedicated hosts → DeH).

desc.de: Automatische Skalierung von EC2-Instanzen. Launch Configurations/Templates, Scaling Policies (Target Tracking, Step, Scheduled), Predictive Scaling.
desc.en: Automatic scaling of EC2 instances. Launch configurations/templates, scaling policies (target tracking, step, scheduled), predictive scaling.

tcpDesc.de: Automatische ECS-Skalierung und Bandwidth-Scaling. AS-Gruppen, AS-Konfigurationen, Scaling-Policies (Alarm-basiert, Scheduled, Lifecycle Hooks).
tcpDesc.en: Automatic ECS scaling and bandwidth scaling. AS groups, AS configurations, scaling policies (alarm-based, scheduled, lifecycle hooks).

alt.de: Kubernetes HPA/VPA auf CCE, Terraform + Cron
alt.en: Kubernetes HPA/VPA on CCE, Terraform + Cron

migration.de: **Alarm-basiertes Scaling.** T Cloud Public AS nutzt Cloud Eye Alarme statt CloudWatch. Target Tracking Policies gibt es nicht — nur Step/Simple Scaling mit Cloud-Eye-Schwellwerten. **AS Configurations.** Launch Configurations → AS Configurations (ähnlich, aber andere Parameter-Namen). Cooldown-Perioden und Health Check Grace Period separat konfigurierbar. **Kein Predictive Scaling.** Vorausschauende Skalierung fehlt komplett. **Flavor-Einschränkung.** Mixed Instance Policies (On-Demand + Spot) nicht verfügbar — eine AS-Konfiguration kann aber bis zu 10 Flavors (mit Prioritäts-Policy) enthalten. **Lifecycle Hooks.** T Cloud Public nutzt SMN-Benachrichtigungen statt SNS/SQS für Hook-Notifications.
migration.en: **Alarm-based scaling.** T Cloud Public AS uses Cloud Eye alarms instead of CloudWatch. Target Tracking policies don't exist — only Step/Simple Scaling with Cloud Eye thresholds. **AS configurations.** Launch Configurations → AS Configurations (similar but different parameter names). Cooldown periods and health check grace period configurable separately. **No Predictive Scaling.** Predictive scaling is completely missing. **Flavor restriction.** Mixed Instance Policies (On-Demand + Spot) not available — but an AS configuration can list up to 10 flavors (with a priority policy). **Lifecycle Hooks.** T Cloud Public uses SMN notifications instead of SNS/SQS for hook notifications.

desc.de: Managed PaaS für Webanwendungen. Automatisches Deployment, Skalierung, Load Balancing, Health Monitoring. Unterstützt Java, .NET, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Go, PHP, Docker.
desc.en: Managed PaaS for web applications. Automatic deployment, scaling, load balancing, health monitoring. Supports Java, .NET, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Go, PHP, Docker.

tcpDesc.de: Kein direktes Pendant auf T Cloud Public. Kein managed PaaS-Service der automatisch Infrastruktur provisioniert und Anwendungen deployt.
tcpDesc.en: No direct equivalent on T Cloud Public. No managed PaaS service that automatically provisions infrastructure and deploys applications.

alt.de: CCE + Helm Charts (Kubernetes-basiert), Docker auf ECS (manuelles Setup), APIG + FunctionGraph (für einfache Web-APIs)
alt.en: CCE + Helm Charts (Kubernetes-based), Docker on ECS (manual setup), APIG + FunctionGraph (for simple web APIs)

migration.de: **Kein PaaS-Pendant.** T Cloud Public bietet keinen Managed PaaS wie Beanstalk. Die gesamte Plattform-Abstraktion (Auto Scaling, Load Balancing, Health Monitoring) muss selbst aufgebaut werden. **Container-Alternative.** CCE mit Helm Charts für Container-Deployments oder CCI für serverlose Container. **Konfigurations-Mapping.** Environment Variables → Kubernetes ConfigMaps/Secrets. .ebextensions → Helm Values oder Init-Container. **Worker Environments.** Beanstalk Worker Environments → DMS-Kafka- oder RocketMQ-Consumer auf CCE. **CI/CD.** Managed Platform Updates gibt es nicht — eigene CI/CD-Pipeline für Rolling Updates und Blue/Green Deployments nötig.
migration.en: **No PaaS equivalent.** T Cloud Public has no managed PaaS like Beanstalk. The entire platform abstraction (auto scaling, load balancing, health monitoring) must be built manually. **Container alternative.** CCE with Helm Charts for container deployments or CCI for serverless containers. **Configuration mapping.** Environment Variables → Kubernetes ConfigMaps/Secrets. .ebextensions → Helm Values or init containers. **Worker environments.** Beanstalk Worker Environments → DMS Kafka or RocketMQ consumers on CCE. **CI/CD.** Managed Platform Updates don't exist — custom CI/CD pipeline needed for rolling updates and blue/green deployments.

desc.de: Physische Server exklusiv für einen Account. Sichtbarkeit von Sockets/Cores für BYOL-Lizenzen (Windows, SQL Server, Oracle), Host Affinity, Auto-Placement, AWS License Manager Integration.
desc.en: Physical servers dedicated to one account. Socket/core visibility for BYOL licenses (Windows, SQL Server, Oracle), host affinity, auto-placement, AWS License Manager integration.

tcpDesc.de: Dedizierte physische Hosts, auf denen ECS-Instanzen exklusiv laufen. Für Lizenz-Compliance (BYOL) und Isolation. Host-Typen u.a. s3/c4/m4 sowie seit 07.07.2026 c9/m9. ⚠️ DeH c3/m3 End of Sale 31.12.2026.
tcpDesc.en: Dedicated physical hosts on which ECS instances run exclusively. For license compliance (BYOL) and isolation. Host types incl. s3/c4/m4 and, since 07.07.2026, c9/m9. ⚠️ DeH c3/m3 end of sale 31.12.2026.

migration.de: **Konzept identisch.** Host allokieren, ECS-Instanzen gezielt auf dem Host platzieren. **Lizenzierung.** Core-/Socket-Informationen für BYOL vorab mit dem Lizenzgeber abstimmen. **Host-Typen.** Verfügbare DeH-Typen weichen von EC2-Host-Familien ab — Flavor-Mapping (z.B. m5 → m9) prüfen; c3/m3-Hosts nicht mehr neu planen. **Nicht verfügbar.** AWS License Manager Integration und Host Resource Groups.
migration.en: **Same concept.** Allocate a host, place ECS instances on it explicitly. **Licensing.** Align core/socket information for BYOL with the licensor upfront. **Host types.** Available DeH types differ from EC2 host families — check flavor mapping (e.g. m5 → m9); do not plan new c3/m3 hosts. **Not available.** AWS License Manager integration and host resource groups.

desc.de: *.metal-Instanzen mit direktem Hardwarezugriff (eigene Hypervisoren, Performance-Counter, Lizenzen). Nitro Enclaves für isolierte Confidential-Computing-Umgebungen.
desc.en: *.metal instances with direct hardware access (own hypervisors, performance counters, licensing). Nitro Enclaves for isolated confidential computing environments.

tcpDesc.de: Physische ECS-Instanzen (BMS) ohne Virtualisierungsschicht, aktuell Typ c7t mit Intel SGX für Confidential Computing (nur EU-DE). Physische c9/m9-Typen laut Roadmap 2027.
tcpDesc.en: Physical ECS instances (BMS) without virtualization layer, currently type c7t with Intel SGX for confidential computing (EU-DE only). Physical c9/m9 types on the roadmap for 2027.

migration.de: **Typauswahl.** Deutlich weniger Bare-Metal-Typen als bei EC2 — aktuell c7t (Intel SGX). Workloads mit GPU- oder großen Memory-Anforderungen auf virtuelle ECS-Flavors prüfen. **Confidential Computing.** Nitro Enclaves → Intel-SGX-Enklaven auf c7t; Anwendungen müssen auf das SGX-SDK bzw. Frameworks wie Gramine angepasst werden. **Provisionierung.** Längere Bereitstellungszeiten als virtuelle ECS einplanen.
migration.en: **Type selection.** Far fewer bare-metal types than EC2 — currently c7t (Intel SGX). Check workloads with GPU or large memory needs against virtual ECS flavors. **Confidential computing.** Nitro Enclaves → Intel SGX enclaves on c7t; applications must be adapted to the SGX SDK or frameworks like Gramine. **Provisioning.** Expect longer provisioning times than virtual ECS.

equivNote.de: Nur wenige physische Typen (c7t/SGX); kein Nitro-Enclaves-Pendant — SGX ist ein anderes Programmiermodell.
equivNote.en: Only few physical types (c7t/SGX); no Nitro Enclaves equivalent — SGX is a different programming model.

tfNote.de: Keine dedizierte BMS-Ressource im Provider dokumentiert; Provisionierung über Konsole/API.
tfNote.en: No dedicated BMS resource documented in the provider; provisioning via console/API.

name: Amazon EC2 AMIs / EC2 Image Builder

desc.de: AMIs als Vorlagen für EC2 (Root- + Daten-Volumes), Sharing über Accounts, Copy über Regionen. EC2 Image Builder automatisiert Bau, Test, Hardening und Verteilung von Images per Pipeline.
desc.en: AMIs as templates for EC2 (root + data volumes), sharing across accounts, copying across regions. EC2 Image Builder automates building, testing, hardening and distributing images via pipelines.

tcpDesc.de: Public Images (Linux, Windows, SAP, Oracle Linux) und Private Images (System-, Daten-, Full-ECS-Images). Import von VHD/VMDK/QCOW2/RAW/ISO über OBS, Export nach OBS, Image Sharing zwischen Projekten/Tenants, Verschlüsselung via KMS.
tcpDesc.en: Public images (Linux, Windows, SAP, Oracle Linux) and private images (system, data, full-ECS images). Import of VHD/VMDK/QCOW2/RAW/ISO via OBS, export to OBS, image sharing between projects/tenants, KMS encryption.

migration.de: **AMI-Migration.** AMI als VMDK/RAW/VHD exportieren (VM Import/Export), nach OBS hochladen und in IMS importieren; Treiber (virtio, cloud-init) vorher prüfen. **Image Builder.** Kein Pipeline-Dienst — Packer mit dem opentelekomcloud/openstack-Builder in CI/CD nutzen. **Sharing.** AMI-Sharing → IMS Image Sharing (Projekt/Tenant-basiert). **Regionen.** Cross-Region-Copy zwischen EU-DE und EU-NL über Export/Import.
migration.en: **AMI migration.** Export the AMI as VMDK/RAW/VHD (VM Import/Export), upload to OBS and import into IMS; check drivers (virtio, cloud-init) first. **Image Builder.** No pipeline service — use Packer with the opentelekomcloud/openstack builder in CI/CD. **Sharing.** AMI sharing → IMS image sharing (project/tenant-based). **Regions.** Cross-region copy between EU-DE and EU-NL via export/import.

equivNote.de: IMS entspricht AMIs; für EC2 Image Builder (Pipelines, Komponenten, Tests) gibt es kein Pendant.
equivNote.en: IMS corresponds to AMIs; there is no equivalent for EC2 Image Builder (pipelines, components, tests).
